Darko lived in a dysfunctional family. His mother, who had decided to adopt three children, seemed to have a preference for them, instead of him, who was supposed to be the only one with whom she shared blood ties.

Although they somehow managed to live as harmoniously as possible, Darko was in charge of being the dark side. Together with one of his older adoptive siblings. And his mother, who was a matriarch, was tough when necessary.

And certainly the same should apply to everyone, praise when necessary and scolding as well. But, for some reason one of the older ones received praise when they clearly needed a punishment for the mischief they got up to.

Just like she did with Darko when he caused problems. But no, apparently that person was more loved and preferred by his own biological mother. And while he, being the only "real" son, took the brunt of it.

Darko couldn't stand it. It seemed that his presence in that place was not welcome. And although he tried to cope with it, with the arrival of a baby from that same person whom he detested with all his being, he had reached his limit.

It was incredible how his entire family deigned to support a vile irresponsibility, without any punishment in return. And although it obviously infuriated him, in a matter of days it turned into satisfaction when he found the same irresponsible person selling their dignity in the dark alleys. Darko could take his revenge for all those years of injustice towards him.
